name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1917: He asked for F-Sets to cross reference what he still does not have, the way he remembers uniques doing. The integration is real - the v1789 focused hunt, which re-reads names the gate held - and it had two defects each hiding the other. It scored every page on a key the reader has never emitted, so every hunted frame was read and paid for with a real vision call and matched against an empty list; grep across every log on his machine shows it has never printed a hit line. And the test covering it handed it that same wrong shape. Second, it filtered to uniques while his last sweep held 41 names of which 41 are set pieces and zero are uniques, so it reported nothing was held and spent zero reads, with a bone helm sitting on six sightings one witness short. It reads the real page shape now and runs per ledger with its own evidence index, its own page kind and its own read cap.
